pending.title: Antibiotic Susceptibility Testing by Disk Diffusion
pending.summary: Standardized Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion on Mueller-Hinton agar: prepare a 0.5 McFarland inoculum, swab a uniform lawn, apply antibiotic disks, incubate at 35 °C, measure inhibition zones and interpret them against CLSI or EUCAST breakpoints with E. coli ATCC 25922 quality control.
pending.keywords: antibiotic susceptibility disk diffusion Kirby-Bauer Mueller-Hinton McFarland zone of inhibition E. coli ATCC 25922 CLSI EUCAST AST

sources.citation: Hudzicki J. Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion susceptibility test protocol. American Society for Microbiology; 2009.

European Committee on Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing (EUCAST). EUCAST disk diffusion method for antimicrobial susceptibility testing, version 7.0. January 2019 (newer versions are available on the EUCAST site).
Ministry of Health, Oman, Directorate General of Specialized Medical Care. Disc diffusion method SOP (MoH/DGSMC/SOP/046/Vers.01). 2023.

pending.title: Luciferase Reporter Assay
pending.summary: Dual-luciferase reporter assay in transfected mammalian cells: co-transfect a firefly reporter and a Renilla control, lyse with passive lysis buffer, read both luciferases sequentially in a luminometer and normalize to calculate fold change.
pending.keywords: luciferase reporter assay dual-luciferase firefly Renilla HEK293T transfection promoter activity passive lysis buffer luminometer normalization
